snippet.text: canonicalKernel F XR c eta X = OutgoingDilation.canonicalKernel F XR eta X + changeRow F XR c eta 0 X, where changeRow row 0 (line 181) is (E F XR c (X,eta)² - OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X,eta)²)/X for the compensated profile; for the pure heat edit heat_differences (line 186) identifies that numerator with HeatTailEdit.squareChange, so the paper's Δ(E²/X) is the row-0 change integrand (the paper's 1/2 is not carried by canonicalKernel, which is E²/X)
